day3_freeze_tag.annotation: Day 3 local execution MVP freeze - Final Freeze Rerun 3 PASS

tool_executor.observed: ExecutionSpec, AttemptContext, Outcome, ToolOutcome, ToolExecutor and ToolRegistry; execute(spec, effect_key, context) is async.

tool_registry.observed: Protocol exposes bindings tuple and resolve(spec); DenyToolRegistry rejects all resolutions.

execution_spec.observed: Frozen dataclass; JSON arguments recursively frozen; from_compiled copies trusted CompiledSpec values.

attempt_context.observed: Frozen attempt_id/deadline/cancelled; expired uses monotonic running-loop time and cooperative Event.

tool_outcome.observed: Three categories; evidence fields effect_key, execution_scope, target, payload_digest, receipt_reference, no_effect_reason.

tool_binding.observed: Frozen six-field identity; constructor hard-codes append_service_note/1/service-demo and validates identifiers/UUID scope.

action_compiler.observed: At most one binding; compiles only exact approved v5 single SIDE_EFFECT append_service_note/1 Plan for service-demo.

executable_registry.observed: Only exact DemoNoteExecutor type is accepted; resolve checks exact six-field binding; missing/mismatch denies.

capability_verifier.observed: LocalDemoAuthorization requires verified issuer/subject/operation/scope and hard-codes the demo tool/version/target/risk.

runtime_composition.observed: compose constructs one DemoNoteExecutor, verifier/policy, ExecutableRegistry, ActionCompiler and SQLite execution repository; recovery precedes serving.

gateway_and_outcome_validation.observed: One durable claim, one dispatch, asyncio.timeout_at, exact four-field outcome correlation, UUID success receipt, whitelisted no-effect reasons; resolver/adapter exceptions after claim conservatively finish Unknown.

action_result_presentation.observed: Succeeded Action result requires the fixed demo-specific message 'The demo note effect was confirmed.'; a non-demo full Action integration needs a separately reviewed result-contract change.

demo_adapter.observed: DemoNoteExecutor validates exact identity/args and scope-bound SQLite store; same-key receipt/payload commit is atomic; ambiguous faults return Unknown.

day1_plan_schema.observed: Explicit tool branches; schema is proposal validation, not execution authority.

day2_approval.observed: Approval is bound to exact canonical Plan identity; retained Plan proof is required for compilation.

day3_architecture_and_freeze.observed: Run + Action, separate approval/authorization/execute, one claim/attempt, no automatic retry; latest fourth-attempt local MVP freeze PASS.

existing_restrictions.registry: Exact DemoNoteExecutor only; exact six-field identity; empty registry denies.
existing_restrictions.compiler: At most one binding; one exact append_service_note/1 SIDE_EFFECT step targeting service-demo after exact approved-Plan checks.
existing_restrictions.tool_catalog: Schema-derived explicit Day 1 proposal metadata for three known tools; not an executable registry.
existing_restrictions.payload_identity: ExecutionSpec.payload_digest uses demo-note-payload-v1 and binds tool/version/target/scope/arguments, but omits adapter_id and binding_revision.
existing_restrictions.result_presentation: Action Succeeded result has a fixed demo-note-specific message; Option A avoids presenting dummy outcomes as persisted Action results.
existing_restrictions.capability: LocalDemoAuthorization is bound to one verifier ToolBinding and exact demo tool/version/target/risk.
existing_restrictions.composition: execution_main.compose constructs only the reviewed DemoNoteExecutor binding.
existing_restrictions.classification: SUCCESS requires exact effect/scope/target/digest, UUID receipt, and no failure reason; CONFIRMED_FAILURE requires null receipt and INPUT_REJECTED/PAYLOAD_CONFLICT/STORE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; otherwise Unknown.
existing_restrictions.registry_denial: Unknown/mismatched production binding is denied without executor dispatch; because resolve occurs after claim inside the gateway exception boundary, the Action is conservatively persisted as Unknown.

frozen_core: safe result CAS/persistence and deterministic recovery
architecture.adapter_boundary: Existing ToolExecutor port; exact trusted static binding required for production dispatch.
architecture.external_provider_boundary: Provider responses/errors are untrusted and require adapter validation; no external provider is integrated.
prohibited_bypasses: dynamic plugin discovery or remote code
adapter-owned permission, Action state, claim or result persistence

dummy_contract.selected_approach: Option A: direct ToolExecutor contract test with trusted synthetic ExecutionSpec; no production registry or Action integration.
dummy_contract.input: Exact synthetic six-field identity; exact arguments {record: string}, nonempty, <=256 UTF-8 bytes, canonical JSON <=1024 bytes; UUID effect_key and attempt_id; injected store object.
dummy_contract.output: Existing ToolOutcome only; exact evidence envelope; success requires verified UUID receipt; failure uses only frozen no-effect reasons; uncertainty/malformed evidence is Unknown.

identity.execution_scope: Trusted fixture UUID; generated by test configuration, not request/model.

failure_modes: explicit pre-effect rejection/conflict: whitelisted confirmed failure
dummy_contract.idempotency_claim: Test-owned SQLite only: atomic local record+receipt; same key/same adapter payload returns same receipt after reopen; same key/conflicting payload rejects without extra mutation. No remote exactly-once claim.
dummy_contract.resource_ownership: Prompt 3 test fixture owns an isolated SQLite DB under pytest tmp_path; adapter receives only the narrow store port and no path.

security.trusted_binding: Static reviewed identity; production dummy registration is not selected.

implementation_plan.prompt4: Add bounded README.md diagram and tests/test_dummy_adapter_e2e.py; direct adapter/store E2E only, not Action/HTTP/browser E2E.
implementation_plan.prompt5: Add docs/day4-final-freeze.md and docs/evidence/day4-final-freeze.json after scoped audit; no delivery unless authorized.
